ios.desc:
Scan food products instantly to identify allergens and hidden ingredients. Healthsnap is your personal food safety assistant for managing allergies and dietary restrictions.

HOW TO USE HEALTHSNAP:

1. Snap a photo of any food or label
2. Instantly get a breakdown of potential allergens, alternatives, and macros.
3. Keep track of foods you've scanned for future reference

Healthsnap uses advanced AI technology to help you:

- Detect common allergens like nuts, dairy, gluten, and more
- Identify hidden ingredients that might cause reactions
- Make informed decisions about what's safe to eat
- Save time reading complicated food labels

Whether you're managing serious allergies, or following dietary restrictions, Healthsnap takes the guesswork out of it!


FEATURES:

- Instant allergen detection
- Easy-to-understand analysis
- Scan history to track previous foods
- Simple, intuitive interface

We believe knowing what's in your food should be easy and accessible. Healthsnap empowers you with instant insights, so you can confidently choose what's best for you and your family.


Have questions or feedback? Contact us at hello@healthsnap.ai. 

NOTE: Healthsnap does not provide medical advice. All insights should be used as guidance only—please consult a healthcare professional for medical concerns.

Unlimited scans requires a subscription.

TERMS: https://healthsnap.ai/tos

quotes.text:
My kid was diagnosed with a gluten allergy last year, and suddenly everything felt like a minefield. Reading labels, Googling ingredients, calling brands, second-guessing every snack — it was exhausting.

So I built an app to take that mental load off.

Healthsnap lets you snap a photo of any food or food label, and it uses AI to analyze it for common allergens (like gluten, dairy, nuts, soy, etc). It gives also gives nutritional facts, alternatives and emergency guidance.

No barcode scanning. No typing. No logins. No BS.

The app is built in SwiftUI. Currently only available for iPhones.

I'd love to get your feedback on the concept.
